brief: Design a desktop dashboard for a regional freight rail operator's dispatch team: live train positions, crew hours, delay exceptions, and maintenance windows. High-trust, data-dense, used 8 hours a day. Build it as a single HTML file with realistic data.
signature: The train graph: every train a sloped path on one time-by-milepost field, work windows as hatched blocks on it, each crew legal limit marked on its own path, the field split at now into recorded past and projected future
dominance: one dominant: the board (exception key nested first with the train graph); train sheet, crew and window registers as peers beneath
